content: MCP TypeScript SDK (npm registry + ts.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/v2, 2026-11-27): v2 is split into @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.4.0, /client 2.4.0, /core 2.4.0, /hono 2.0.2, /node 2.1.2, /express, /fastify, /server-legacy, /codemod; Node >=20; peer zod ^4.2.0. v2 implements spec revision 2026-07-28 (stateless, no initialize, server/discover). createMcpHandler(factory) returns a web-standard fetch handler; default legacy:'stateless' also serves 2025-era clients from the same factory; legacy:'reject' makes it modern-only. v2 server never serves HTTP+SSE. Server is OAuth resource server only (requireBearerAuth, oauthMetadataResponse); AS helpers frozen in server-legacy. Monolithic @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is at 1.32.2 (v1 line) and does not support file transfers.
